children: US precision timing tech maker's fiscal Q1 revenue rose 70% yr/yr to record levels
Operating margin exceeded 22% as profitability improved significantly
Company's funded backlog reached $129 mln, up 82% yr/yr, supporting further growth
Company expects to be cash-generative on annual basis going forward
Frequency Electronics maintains annual revenue target of $150 mln or more by fiscal 2029
END-MARKET EXPANSION - Co said growth was supported by sales into larger end-markets, including space and defense applications
OPERATING LEVERAGE - Co said higher sales volumes allowed it to demonstrate significant profitability improvement, with gross margin expanding to approximately 46% and operating margin exceeding 22%
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the electrical components & equipment peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Frequency Electronics Inc is $81.00, about 27.3% above its September 9 closing price of $63.64
The stock recently traded at 50 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 72 three months ago
